purpose: Define a reversible glyph-path packet suitable for BIN/HEX storage and QR transport.
glyphIdentity: GLYPH := ordered PATH + version + optional semantic/correspondence refs

fields.name: nodes
fields.item: typed 14-bit AK frame OR canonical MF tuple token

fields.name: checksum
fields.type: CRC32 or stronger versioned integrity code

nodeKinds.MF: tag + layer0(3 bits) + sector0(7 bits) = 10 payload bits

qrTransport.rule: QR is a transport surface, not semantic authority

visualProjection.pixel: render PATH nodes through PixelMap coordinates
visualProjection.isopixel: render the same nodes through iso2D transform
visualProjection.invariant: all three must decode/reference the same underlying PATH

next: Generate first HNK glyph candidates only from approved linguistic/semantic targets by authoring PATHs; do not draw first and reverse-engineer meaning afterward.
